title: Case Study A: 2025 Afar Rifting & Hayli Gubbi Eruption
subtitle: 32 km Magma Dike Propagation & First Eruption in ~12,000 Years
recommended_radar_reason: Arid, unvegetated volcanic terrain optimal for C-Band (5.6 cm) phase coherence

timeline_weeks.narrative: Nominal tectonic divergence between the Nubian and Arabian plates (~16 mm/yr). Minimal seismicity and clear atmosphere.

timeline_weeks.phase: Subsurface Magma Migration at Erta Ale
timeline_weeks.narrative: Deep magma reservoir inflation beneath northern Erta Ale segment detected via InSAR. Small earthquake swarm clustered at 8-12 km depth.
timeline_weeks.action: Trigger daily C-Band SAR processing; notify Ethiopian Geological Survey.

timeline_weeks.narrative: A 18 km long magma dike is migrating rapidly southward toward Hayli Gubbi shield volcano. Crustal graben opening exceeds 75 mm in 7 days.
timeline_weeks.action: Place regional civil protection on HIGH ALERT. Restrict vehicle traffic along Afdera-Erta Ale desert track.

timeline_weeks.narrative: Severe surface swelling at Hayli Gubbi flank. TROPOMI detects major SO2 degassing anomaly (>9.8 DU). Shallow earthquake swarm (depth < 4 km).
timeline_weeks.action: IMMEDIATE EVACUATION: Evacuate pastoral settlements within 15 km of Hayli Gubbi. Issue Red Civil Aviation VONA alert.

timeline_weeks.narrative: FISSURE ERUPTION CONFIRMED: Hayli Gubbi breaches after ~12,000 years. Effusive basaltic lava fountains and 10 km ash/gas column.
timeline_weeks.action: Full emergency disaster response active. Airspace closed. Safe zone relocation to Logiya/Semera.

impact_metrics.nearest_medical_facility: Afdera Primary Health Clinic (26.4 km NW)
impact_metrics.hazard_corridor: Erta Ale - Borale Ale - Hayli Gubbi Volcanic Axis
